description:
## What's new

- **Links open the app like Spotify.** Tapping a shared link now shows the familiar Open with Lunara chooser and jumps straight into the app when it is installed, falling back to the website only when it is not.
- **Rich link previews.** When a shared link is pasted into WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram, it now shows the real cover, title and artist instead of a plain page.
- **Share sends picture and link together.** The share action now attaches both the story picture and the openable link, so recipients get the card and something that opens the app.
- **Smoother sharing.** The share sheet no longer stutters the app while it builds the picture.
